definitions.gloss: near death, on the verge of death
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being close to death, either literally of a person or animal, or figuratively of an organization, project, or system on the brink of failure.

examples.japanese: {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was found in a near-death state.

examples.japanese: {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}い→負う：02017_ou⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Despite suffering near-fatal injuries, he called for help.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧し、{瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}っていた→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: The company's management deteriorated and it fell into a moribund state.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the set phrase {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (near-death state) and {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧ (near-fatal injuries). Can be used figuratively for organizations, industries, or systems on the brink of collapse.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a noun and as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective modifier: {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ (a patient near death).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: near-death condition
- {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧: near-fatal injuries
- {瀕死|ひんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: patient near death
